pages: The Nakahara mansion was quiet as it always was on these late nights, the thin facade hiding the tension resting in every corner of the house, a breath away from shattering. Doctor Nakahara and Chuuya hadn’t argued today, but that made it just more primed to break and made Chuuya all the more inclined to avoid it. Chuuya wasn’t stupid; he knew where the limits of his father’s patience lay, and tonight those limits were much smaller. Which is why Chuuya was currently slumped against the bathroom wall, the cold tiles producing a slight shiver from Chuuya, one hand dug into his hair, the other just dropped against the cold ceramic. Quietly listening for any footsteps, he paused, going quiet as he heard footsteps outside his bedroom. No clicking of the door unlocking or opening; the room adjacent to the bathroom, the footsteps paused for a moment before starting up again, and fading back into silence after a few more seconds. Chuuya untangled his hand from his hair and dropped it. Chuuya pushed himself up and shouldered the door open, walking back into his bedroom. He just hoped Doctor Nakahara was going to sleep. Chuuya went and collapsed back onto his bed, a hand pressed to his temple. God, he was done with his father; something like tonight was nothing new. The house was tense enough that you could taste it; it was either that or arguing until someone’s throat gave out or Chuuya got locked in his room. Chuuya hated it, he was tired of it to a bone-deep level. He would handle it somehow; he always would.

The night was bright outside.
Annoyingly bright, as Dazai thought.

A loud sigh rang out in the dark “room” as Dazai shifted to hug his pillow tightly.
No matter what position he shifted to , nothing felt quite right.

Sleep didn't come easily to Osamu Dazai.


He turned to lay flat on his back watching the ceiling of the shipping tank , silently counting the little dents on it.

Sigh.

He shifted again and nuzzled his cheek against his pillow. His arms stung as he hugged the pillow tightly but he didn't want to separate himself from its warmth , nor did he have the energy to move anyway.  


His eyes wandered aimlessly in the dark as it landed upon the unscrewed sharpener blades on his desk. 
He couldn't see them properly, but he could imagine them from his memory.
He thought maybe he should've cleaned those blades. Or was it okay to let the blood dry on them?

Such were the thoughts that invaded his sleep. 

…..


“.....”


“Jeez…” , he said as he stood up from his bed—his bed wasn't so comfortable after all—and turned on the flashlight on his phone.

Maybe he should just sit in silence…..or…



A drowsy smile made itself to his lips.



…Or….he could just think of ways to annoy Chuuya.


He sat back as he thought of ways.
Surprisingly—unlike his usual self—no idea made its way to his head.

He must be very tired. But he couldn't sleep because—ugh—the 7 cups of coffee. The sugar crash from all the snacks he had eaten all day along with the caffeine wasn't helping at all.

He was tired and miserable, yet he couldn't possibly fall asleep.

A light bulb practically appeared above his head.

“Oh….” , he said hoarsely as he picked up his phone again.

This time not to turn on or off the flashlight, but to call Chuuya.

His fingers hovered over the button on his phone as he selected Chuuya's number.

Chuuya was going to kill him if he called him at this wonderful ungodly hour.


Wonderful 


Dazai thought , before putting the tiny flip phone next to hear as he listened to the ring while he adjusted the bandages on his wrist.


Chuuya was trying to go to sleep, well that's what he told himself, when he heard his phone buzzing. He already knew who it was, but he glanced at it anyway. Maybe it would be Shirase, but no, it was exactly who he thought.

Chuuya stared at his phone, buzzing in his hand; of course, it was Dazai. Chuuya let it ring for a moment or two before declining the call; he was not doing this right now; he was not entertaining that stupid bastard’s bullshit, especially this late. 

He glanced out his windows, the moon casting cones of light across the floor; it looked peaceful outside. He could probably get away with sneaking out; Paul would probably be more than happy to let me in no matter the time, but Paul also always managed to give him a headache. Murase was probably asleep. Shirase would never let him in; He entertained the idea of going to Dazai for a second before he realized the stupidity and scoffed at himself, so he discarded that idea, whatever.

He sat there on the edge of his bed, grabbing his phone; Dazai had called again; god, he couldn’t believe he was actually considering answering his phone. The ringing was getting on his nerves, and it wasn’t like he had much else to do or think about besides the almost suffocating tension filling the house.

He really had gotten desperate, hadn’t he? 

Tch.

Chuuya declined the call again; he would rather be choked to death than give that shitty mackerel any satisfaction or hear his voice for more than 5 seconds outside school. So he set his phone on do not disturb and shoved it away from him

It’s not like ignoring Dazai was an easy task at school considering they shared almost every class, so no need to test his own patience more. He scowled; he hated even thinking about the bastard more than needed, so he shifted his attention back out the window, back to the peaceful night, the slightly muffled chirps of the cicadas; it was nice, some distraction.
At least there was that.

Dazai stared at his phone as the screen read “declined” for what was the 7th time.


He knew it would happen, of course—but that didn't stop him.
After all , he really hadn't dialed Chuuya's number solely to annoy him. Maybe somewhere deep down—though he'd never admit it—he needed to hear someone's voice.


He has quite the good relationship with his teacher Oda (whom he liked to call “Odasaku”). But calling him at such a time did not feel right. 


“Oda must've been pretty tired from teaching all day….not him….” , Dazai thought to himself before jumping up from the uncomfortable bed as he felt blood drip down his wrist just slightly—a single drop of blood wouldn't have scared Dazai shitless. It did only because his thoughts had wandered off to wondering if Oda or anyone would care—or even notice—if he died. 


It took him a moment to recover from the depths of his thoughts and realise that he had picked on his bandages so much that the bandage came slightly undone , ergo , the wound was left free to bleed down his arm.

He looked at it and then at the uneasy thought of washing the wound. 
Eugh.
He'd prefer if it just stayed like that. 

He adjusted the bandages back again to cover the wound properly before he lay on the bed and stared at his phone and the dust particles that appeared when the flashlight hit the dark room. 


No….he really needed to hear someone's voice. He was getting desperate and his urges chose the worst time to knock at his door.


He got up , unable to keep laying down for even a breath longer in the suffocating silence, and grabbed his phone—no no no. This was far too suffocating—and dialed Chuuya's number once again 


If Chuuya didn't pick up? That's fine. He'd call again and again. 


He knew the slug had the temper of a bomb set to explode in 30 seconds. 
So he would pick it up eventually.

Chuuya had been ignoring the calls, though it was only annoying him more and more every time, until eventually he glanced over scowling, and snatched his phone from beside him, furiously answering

“What the fuck do you want!?”

Was the first thing Chuuya yelled, he was, really not in the mood for Dazai, even the thought of the fuckers voice grated on him.


“Okay , ouch” , Dazai said into the phone as he heard Chuuya's voice. He felt a mixture of slyness and relief register in his body all at once.


“I was trying to sleep, you bastard,” Chuuya responded sharply, lowering his voice slightly, though none of the venom left his voice. Sure, he probably wouldn’t have slept anyway, but Dazai’s call snapped him out of any hope of sleep.

“Uh-huh. Chuuya knows it's a lie. And it's so sweet that you were trying to sleep, as I think!”
“What's better than annoying someone who's already half dead–half awake?”

Dazai's chipper voice rang out.
Dazai had internally cringed at the way it rang through his room like a questioning echo. But at least it made him feel less lonely—no. Never lonely. He just felt alone.


“...do you have anything worth actually saying or are you just fucking with me?” He snapped in response; he could think of many things better, including but not limited to throwing Dazai into the harbour. 

He had stopped thinking about how suffocating the house felt,
His thoughts instead shifted to the annoying asshole currently on the phone with him. Something he would never admit was a welcome distraction.

“I feel alone and my room is miserable” 
It was just at the tip of Dazai's tongue.
They both often talked—both at school and on call alike—many things went unsaid.


Chuuya didn't care about Dazai enough and Dazai didn't want to always carry the burden that–oh, he spoke to someone about how he felt.


Instead he just steered the conversation back onto Chuuya.

“Fufu~”
“Nothing worth saying!!! I'm here because I know you give reactions like a noble person giving money to charity!!”

He went quiet for a moment, expecting a loud outburst from Chuuya. But before he did so , his lips moved on his own :


“Anddd! I know you're hiding from your father”


Dazai said starting with the same chipper tone but lowering his tone—he’d rather have his organs removed than to admit that—a little bit.


He knew it was a touchy subject.


It didn't set Chuuya off like fireworks. No.
It just made Chuuya go quiet.


If there was anything Dazai was here for—it was Chuuya's voice. He didn't want radio silence and then “call ended” in a swift moment.


Dazai never dared to address Chuuya's father as his “dad”.
He knew Chuuya didn't—and never had—felt quite the comfort to call him “dad” and not father.


Even Dazai cared that much , okay?

Chuuya stared at his phone for a second, tch.
Well, at least that was a perfect reminder of why he hated talking to the bastard, he always had to go and talk about shit that wasn't his business.

He threw his phone across the bed and scowled, gritting his teeth. Staining his ears just to make sure he hadn't accidentally woke his father up, he collapsed onto his back, looking around his dark room for a minute, before going to stare at the ceiling, the silence and tension he was newly reminded of pressed against him, uncomfortably.

Whatever, the chirps of cicadas had started getting on his nerves again, so he didn't have anything else to focus on, just the silence of the dark room.

He closed his eyes, raising his arm and putting it over his eyes. He didn't know why he was almost disappointed, he shouldn't have expected anything different. 

Tch, 

He just wanted a distraction, that's all it was.

He went back to trying to go to sleep, or more hoping for sleep, though sleep didn't come, even after what felt like forever, he blamed it on the shitty mackerel of course.

So he dropped his arm away from his face, and sat up again, he really was restless, so he shifted his thoughts forcefully.



Chuuya hadn't hung up.


Dazai stared at his phone as he watched the time on his screen go up second-by-second.


Dazai wasn't really staring at the screen. He had un-focused his vision the moment he heard the silence hit.


He plopped back onto his bed as he put the phone next to the pillow he hugged while sleeping before he wrapped his arms around the pillow , listening to every rustle that made its way out the phone speaker from Chuuya's side.


Dazai really had no energy right now.
But he needed to hear someone's voice.
But to hear someone's voice , he'd have to speak first.


“EUGH , WHAT A TERRIBLE SITUATION”
Dazai thought to himself.


The numbing pills he had taken earlier crashed his entire body into weakness.

That combined with a deadly sugar crash , sleep deprivation , the radio silence , and his thoughts was fucking Dazai's head up.


He let out a single shaky breath , resisting tears to the fullest–


Fuck


Why did he keep the phone so close to him?


The phone totally caught that.
Dazai's eyes widened for a second before dropping drowsily.


He accepted his fate.
That sounded pathetic.

The noise snapped Chuuya out of his thoughts (complaining about Shirase in his head), he glanced over, pausing for a moment.

The noise was weird considering it was coming from Dazai of all people, and almost suspicious; he reached for his phone, huffing slightly

“...oi, shitty mackerel?” Chuuya just said dryly, readying a scoff for what he expected to be a usual answer of sarcasm or mocking.


Dazai wanted to control the sound so much. But too bad—he couldn't turn back time.


Dazai didn't want to really say anything. But he wanted—no—needed to hear someone's voice.


He didn't reply with his chipper tone.
He responded with a voice that sounded both a very pathetic attempt at sarcasm and the heaviness of days settling into one line.



“Do you think anyone would care if I disappeared, Chuuya?”



There was no answer from Chuuya’s side for a moment, quieter in a different way; the question kinda caught him off guard. Of course, Dazai constantly talked about suicide and killing himself, but this felt diffrent, a much more loaded question, 

“Of course someone would notice; it would be hard not to.” 
He said, his voice a slight forced scoff, but there wasn’t much force behind it, just a veil of dryness hiding the worry buried in the statement; the silence after was tense, just another layer to be added to the suffocating feeling.


“Aw , does that mean the slug thinks I'm memorable?” 

Dazai made a horrible attempt at a sarcastic joke.
All it did was make him sound—well—depressed , like he'd spent 10 hours chain smoking and reading classic Russian literature.

There was a silence in between. It lifted a bit of the tension.


“Eugh , just come over or something~”
“I don't have any of my homework done”
“The slug should do it for me!!!”

That was Dazai's way of inviting Chuuya over.

He didn't want to sound more pathetic than he already did but oh , the world hated him.


Every word he spoke made him sound closer to tears—and maybe he was.


He'd rather die beside Chuuya than to admit he felt so frustrated that he was on the verge of tears even to himself. 


He put his forehead against his pillow and clutched it tightly like a kid hanging onto a toy they just bought.


He let out another shaky breath because he had already lost all of his self-respect. 

And he was too tired to actually cover it up otherwise.

Chuuya hadn’t hung up; he lay there considering it all for a moment. If the bastard let himself be that vulnerable, who knows what he might actually do some stupid shit...Chuuya pushed himself up, digging the bag from under his bed. He snuck out of the house more than he stayed, so he always had a bag. He grabbed his headphones, throwing them on top of his phone

“I’m not doing your homework, asshole”
He just snapped, though there wasn’t heat or annoyance behind it, not really as he threw the bag over his shoulder and connected his headphones to his phone; he would be fucked if his father heard him.

Chuuya opened his door and slipped out, quietly starting down the stairs still thinking about Dazai’s question, and how…upset he sounded; it was so unlike how Dazai normally acted, it still threw Chuuya off

And worried him, but would Chuuya admit that?, you would sooner get Chuuya willingly tortured.

“..tch, don’t do something stupid,” Chuuya muttered once he got down the stairs. He unlocked the front door and shoved it open, closing it behind him quietly and starting, not to Dazai’s shipping container (Chuuya still didn’t really understand, but whatever), but to the closest convenience store. He might as well get Dazai some shit.

Dazai stared at his phone.
He felt the sudden urge to throw up.
He felt all too warm.

Chuuya wouldn't mind if Dazai was a little high when he arrived, right?


Dazai got up and opened his closest before kneeling to take out a small container from the small compartment.

In that container he kept—if it wasn't obvious—drugs.


Mori had let him try them without a word.
Dazai found them as an easy escape from whatever the hell was wrong with him.


He had many of them. 
Cannabis , Amphetamines , Opioids.

Everything.


He felt like the world was flowing like a river afterwards, but that's okay.


He sat back on his bed and hung up. He was certainly out of his mind now.

He had taken almost all of them—small amounts—together. He'd never done it before. He wondered what the effects would be….

When Chuuya got to Dazai’s shipping container he had a bag full of random crab shit he had found at the convenience store, he set the bag down and pulled the container’s door open with a slight grunt, he looked around for a minute, letting out a small sigh of relief when he saw Dazai, not dead,

Chuuya hadn’t exactly known what Dazai was doing after he hung up, after examining Dazai for a moment or two, Chuuya tossed the convenience store bag at Dazai, pulling the container door closed behind him with a loud creak

He recognized Dazai was high; Chuuya had been a homeless teenager for a while a few years ago, he should know it more than anyone. He huffed slightly, throwing his personal bag down, and walking over to the bed beside Dazai, examining him for a moment longer.


“Tch, at least it wasn’t what I was expecting.” He muttered dryly. Dazai was alive, just high out of his mind; he would wait. Chuuya didn’t have anything else to do anyway.

He sat on the edge of the bed, still watching Dazai out of the corner of his eye, not saying anything, not like there was much to say.

Dazai shifted closer to Chuuya before unexpectedly wrapping his arms around Chuuya's waist.


“I want to take care of Chuu….” 
Dazai said as he trailed off at Chuuya's name.

Okay. He must've abused the shit out of those drugs to end up like this.


His eyes screamed needy right now.

It was the “give me all your attention right now” expression.


Dazai put his head onto Chuuya's chest as he tightly clutched Chuuya like a human teddy bear.




Chuuya simply looked unimpressed

“You’re high,” was his dry response, not that it would change much. “If anything, I’m taking care of you.” he muttered to himself, rolling his eyes.

Chuuya told himself the touch meant nothing; Dazai was just high; you do weird shit when you’re high. He just sighed.

He didn’t push Dazai off, just let him stay like that; whatever, Dazai would probably fall asleep soon enough. This was better than Dazai doing his usual stupid shit

So he let Dazai cling; it didn’t matter, it didn’t mean anything, so whatever.

Dazai looked up at Chuuya and sighed like his usual obnoxious self would.

“Chuuya…. I watch you all day at school ; that's why my homework’s never complete….”


Dazai's eyes were nothing but a cloudy void.


“It won't matter to you much if I died”

“But I want to take care of you”

Dazai moves his hand to rest over Chuuya's.


“I watch you talk to everyone. And it burns”
“It burns seeing you happy with someone else”

Dazai spoke in a chipper voice next as if what he was saying were his thoughts he'd refused to accept himself and pushed them so far down that his consciousness could barely handle them.


“You might not even care , but I'd cut myself to the third layer of my skin if you left me”

“…..”


“Everything hurts , Chuuya….” 
He suddenly said in a “I'm-almost-about-to-cry” tone.

The only feeling Chuuya registered properly was Dazai's lips pressing against his collar and how warm Dazai was despite the cold temperature of the room inside.

“I want to make you happy. Only me”
Chuuya just stared; he didn’t respond to anything said, his eyes unreadable and intense, locked on Dazai.

“You’re high, shut up.” Chuuya muttered absently, “...go to sleep..” He said louder, carefully prying Dazai off of him, and standing up, grabbing his own bag, and stepped over to the desk, making sure Dazai wasn’t looking, he shoved all parts of the disassembled pencil sharpener into his bag; he didn’t trust Dazai with it.

He buried the parts in his bag, closed his bag and threw it again to the side. He stood there staring at Dazai, trying to process everything Dazai said.

It…It was….odd, hearing all that, and it only made Chuuya’s chest tighten, god what was he even supposed to say in response to all that, no words came to him.

His face was twisted, his mouth pulled into a tight line, eyes narrowed, before he sighed sharply, whatever, he would dissect that all later, first, he searched through the desk, until he found some more bandages and some antiseptic.

He went back over, dropping back on the bed beside Dazai; he still didn’t say anything, still having no clue really what to say, but whatever. He didn’t see a need to say anything as he started unwrapping the bandages on Dazai’s wrist, applying the antiseptic to the cuts and then starting to rebandage Dazai’s wrists.

Dazai merely stared at Chuuya.

His void-like eyes stared into Chuuya's soul as if he could read every thought that went through Chuuya's head.

It seemed that he was only zoned out , however.


Because just the next second, he felt a tremble in his body and a chill go down his spine.

He was definitely getting sick tomorrow…

He put his head against Chuuya's chest and his eyelids gave up on trying to remain open and he fell completely limp against the redhead ,allowing himself this moment of comfort and warmth as he snuggled closer
to Chuuya even in his sleep.

By the time Chuuya was leaving, the sun was already starting to set, and Dazai was asleep and in better condition than earlier.
 Chuuya was starting to try to dissect all that Dazai said. Chuuya was walking slowly, trying to get home slower; he did realize one thing: Dazai meant it, all of it.

And then he realized the second more important thing:

The second realization brought that familiar dread curling in his gut, because that meant:
Another person relying on him, another person to take care of, 

Fuck.

Maybe it was selfish, maybe it was the wrong thing to focus on, but it’s all he could think of, and it’s so much harder, because he knew Dazai was basically always one wrong move from killing himself, and even if he wouldn’t say it, he did care.

He wanted to throw up. God knows if he could do this again. He glanced down at Dazai again, at least slightly more peaceful while he was sleeping, and he knew he would stay anyway; he wasn’t stupid; he knew he was loyal, too loyal.

After a while, he groaned into his hands; He glanced at his bag, atleast he made it easier on himself he had taken whatever shit he could that Dazai could use in a suicide attempt. The fucker would definitely be extremely annoying about it, whatever.

He dug his fingers into his hair; some part of him acknowledged that factor that Dazai was clearly in love with him, but Chuuya didn’t give a damn about that right now; he would process that later.

He just continued walking, going back to thinking about the other thing; maybe that’s what was causing his dread. Going home, he had stayed out much longer than he wanted; his father absolutely had noticed, and that would end horribly.

Maybe he should just go to Murase’s house.

That would only make his father angrier, so it wasn’t worth it.

He scowled at the ground, trying to ignore the growing nervous ache in his chest, he really didn’t want to have to deal with his father.

He kicked at the ground, “..I’m so fucking dead.” He scoffed to himself

Tch, whatever.

He would be fine, at least that’s what he told himself.

Dazai woke up later that evening once Chuuya had left.


Shit.


Did he spend a whole day sleeping? 


Great. More missing assignments and homework…..


But Dazai could think about that later….but right now….

His gaze shifted from objects onto other objects as if they held answers for his current state : head aching somewhere he couldn't quite locate, his shoulders felt heavy and his stomach turned with the slightest move he made. 


His mouth felt dry and everything in his body ached, but he couldn't quite tell where exactly.

He laid back , sinking into the bed ,unable to take the pressure of sitting anymore.

He felt so incredibly numb and frustrated with the way his body and surroundings were at the moment.

He couldn't quite pinpoint what exactly was causing this shitty reaction of his hair sticking to his neck uneasily in a way he'd quite never focused that much on, and the way his blankets and bedsheets moved around him. 


He felt sick in a way that felt too sudden for the body to register , just like when you decide that you want to isolate yourself from the people close to you and stay inside for a whole day or for a year , at the very least.


His gaze shifted lazily onto his wrist and the slightly crumpled but evidently new gauze on his wrist. That hit a nerve in his brain and suddenly everything snapped in his brain at once like a painful kick delivered to your stomach.


He would've physically groaned if it weren't for the fact that even after a heavy dosage of drugs , he could maintain at least something the next day.


Right.


Chuuya. The drugs. The cuts. 


His gaze immediately swept over to his desk only to find….. nothing there other than a small bag there full of random stuff.


He got up with a slight tremble in his thighs with his headache returning at full force.

He was tired…he could use some more rest and lay back down. Maybe that would've been the best thing to do.


But stepping back into the bed kind of felt harder than walking to the desk , and at the same time , somehow harder. 


He needed water….his throat felt weird.


But it wasn't like he was unused to this. No , quite the opposite actually. It was just that the intensity of the after effects were much more than what he was used to ; he found it both amusing and irritating.

He despised pain to the moon and back (or maybe even more).


After drinking some water from his bedside—and spilling it on his shirt—he walked over to the desk and opened the back with his weirdly light, and what felt useless, thumbs.


Oh.



Chuuya had got him quite the stuff….


Pocky sticks? How childish.


Dazai almost rolled his eyes before realising if he did that , his brain would pop right out his head. .


Despite the silly treat, he felt a little warm—or maybe it was the side effects.


A cramp in the stomach was all it took for Dazai to head back to his bed and mayyybe take a litttttle more rest.


He might as well repay Chuuya back someday.

He cringed at his own thoughts.

“Ew , since when did I become so noble?”

He thought to himself as he turned to his side and closed his eyes.

He'd still think about it though.

It had been a few hours by the time silence settled back over the Nakahara mansion. Chuuya’s room was locked from the outside; Doctor Nakahara was in his office. He had been mad at Chuuya, but not in an explosive way; Doctor Nakahara’s anger was cold and suffocating; it felt like being drowned.

And in his room, Chuuya was sitting against his bed; his head was pounding, his chest ached, though he couldn’t tell if it was from being kicked multiple times or from the tension still pressing hard enough to suffocate him, he could barely breathe.

He tensed up as he heard footsteps echoing outside his room, the sound slightly muffled, but they rung in Chuuya’s ears. 

He didn’t move a muscle, his heart suddenly turning into a hummingbird's wings in his chest. That pressure tightened.

It felt like forever until the footsteps started up, fading into silence again. Chuuya relaxed slowly, slumping slightly.

Chuuya looked up at the ceiling; god, he hated this all so much. On top of everything he had to deal with, everything with Dazai wouldn’t help; some part of him was tempted to instead focus on the fact that Dazai clearly had feelings, and the fact he might have some back, but that was a completely separate issue, Chuuya once again pushed aside.

The pressure didn’t ease; in fact, his chest only tightened as he thought more about it. He scowled, glaring at the floor. This whole thing was stupid, and he hated it.

He dug a hand into his hair, a sharp exhale escaped him, he tried to relax, tried to shove it out of his head, but it didn’t work, and that stupid pressure only pressed harder, he glanced at his bag, he knew the pencil sharpener blades were in there.

He just stared; his heart started beating hard again. His hand twitched, and he nearly reached for the bag before he screwed his eyes shut.


Tch

He kicked the bag under his bed, he really was pathetic huh….


Chuuya sat on the edge of his bed, a slight groan escaping from him


And that pressure was still there, and Chuuya hated it, his thoughts traveled back to the pencil sharpener blades, he stared a hole through the bed to where the bag was, he considered grabbing it.

Maybe that would ease the pressure, make it better..

Before Chuuya's train of thoughts even reached its destination, there was a knock at his window.

It was gentle but loud enough for Chuuya to catch very easily. 

Dazai had been beyond bored , so his genius idea was to sneak into Chuuya's room , because why not?

Dazai stayed where he is on the ladder with his cheek pressed against one of his palms as he waited for Chuuya to check the sound.

Chuuya paused for a second, before glancing back at his window, and of course it was Dazai.

Chuuya scowled deepened, and he kicked the bag further under his bed, no use in Dazai finding it.

He glared at the window; he considered not letting Dazai in, but his father would most definitely see Dazai at some point. Chuuya groaned, the familiar annoyance flooding him, the blades forgotten.

He stood up, walked to the window, opened it and pulled Dazai in roughly, shoving him onto the floor, slamming the window and locking it again, glaring at Dazai.

“What the fuck made you think, to bring a ladder, that’s really obvious and I can’t do shit about?” Chuuya snapped, glaring, ugh, if his father saw it

He didn’t need more fighting, especially with this asshole here, his earlier concerns pushed to the back of his head.

“Ah-ah~ My ears~” , Dazai said in his usual bird-like voice.
His voice always sounded like the chirp-chirp of a bird—very annoying one at that.


Dazai got up before opening the window and pulled the ladder inside and put it in the corner of the room , and closed the window before wiping imaginary dust off of his trousers.

“See?” 

He said before walking around the room without permission. He stopped at Chuuya's desk and stuffed his mouth with the popcorn kept there and sat down on Chuuya's bed like a very lazy cat. 

“Why are you even here?” Chuuya snapped, voice starting to rise, before taking a quick glance at the door and lowering his voice.

Chuuya walked back over, huffing, before sitting on the edge of his bed, the familiar idea of choking the bastard popping back up.

At least that would shut him up, and that would be a very welcome change. 

Those thoughts paused when Chuuya glanced back at the door; he hadn’t even noticed the pressure had eased before he felt it coming back at the thought of his father finding Dazai in here, 

Chuuya would be so fucking dead, and it would be the fault of the stupid asshole currently chewing on popcorn beside him. His fingers started tapping on the bed.
